name: Afrikaans
about: Grade 11 Afrikaans First Additional Language: idioms and proverbs, figurative language, fixed comparisons and formal writing.

lessons.title: Die kat uit die boom kyk

words.af: die bobbejaan agter die bult gaan haal
en: worry about problems before they happen

words.af: met die deur in die huis val
die kat uit die boom kyk

af: Moenie die bobbejaan agter die bult gaan haal nie.
en: Do not worry about problems before they happen.
Do not cross your bridges before you come to them.

af: Hy het met die deur in die huis geval en gesê dat hy bedank.
en: He came straight to the point and said that he was resigning.
He got straight to the point and said that he was resigning.
He came straight to the point and said he was resigning.
He got straight to the point and said he was resigning.

af: Ek gaan eers die kat uit die boom kyk.
en: I am going to wait and see first.
First I am going to wait and see.
I will wait and see first.

af: Nou is ons in die sop!

drills.task: Vervang die woorde met 'n idioom: "wag om te sien wat gebeur".
drills.en: Replace with the idiom for "wait and see what happens".
drills.from: Ek gaan eers wag om te sien wat gebeur.
to: Ek gaan eers die kat uit die boom kyk.

drills.task: Vervang die woorde met 'n idioom: "is in die moeilikheid".
drills.en: Replace with the idiom for "is in trouble".
drills.from: Die span is in die moeilikheid.
to: Die span is in die sop.

words.af: die spyker op die kop slaan
en: hit the nail on the head

af: Almal moet hand uit die mou steek.
en: Everyone has to lend a hand.

af: Die dief is op heterdaad betrap.
Jy het die spyker op die kop geslaan.
en: You hit the nail on the head.
You have hit the nail on the head.

af: Die vakansie was net 'n blou Maandag.
en: The holiday lasted only a very short while.
The holiday was over in a very short while.
The holiday was only a very short while.

to: Almal moet hand uit die mou steek.

drills.task: Vervang die woorde met 'n idioom: "presies reg gesê".
drills.en: Replace with the idiom for "said exactly the right thing".
to: Jy het die spyker op die kop geslaan.

af: Oefening baar kuns.
Haastige spoed is selde goed.
Wie laaste lag, lag die lekkerste.
en: He who laughs last laughs best.
He who laughs last laughs longest.

af: Waar daar 'n wil is, is daar 'n weg.
en: Where there is a will, there is a way.

af: Al is die leuen nog so snel, die waarheid agterhaal hom wel.
en: However fast a lie travels, the truth catches up with it.
The truth always catches up with a lie.

af: Sy is so bang soos 'n muis.
en: She is as scared as a mouse.
She is as timid as a mouse.

af: Hy is 'n leeu op die veld.
en: He is a lion on the field.

af: Die wind fluister deur die bome.
en: The wind whispers through the trees.

af: Haar oë is soos sterre.

drills.en: Turn the simile into a metaphor (drop "soos").
Turn the simile into a metaphor.
Turn the metaphor into a simile (add "soos").

words.af: so oud soos die Kaapse wapad

af: Die water is so koud soos ys.
en: The water is as cold as ice.

af: My oupa is so sterk soos 'n os.
en: My grandfather is as strong as an ox.

af: Daardie grap is so oud soos die Kaapse wapad.
en: That joke is as old as the hills.

af: Die band is so plat soos 'n pannekoek.
en: The tyre is as flat as a pancake.

drills.en: Replace "baie koud" with a fixed comparison.
to: Die water is so koud soos ys.

drills.en: Replace "baie sterk" with a fixed comparison.
to: Hy is so sterk soos 'n os.

drills.en: Replace "baie oud" with a fixed comparison.
to: Dit is so oud soos die Kaapse wapad.

af: Geagte Meneer
Ek wil graag aansoek doen om die betrekking.
en: I would like to apply for the position.

af: My CV is as bylae aangeheg.
en: My CV is attached as an attachment.
My CV is attached as an appendix.

af: Ek sien uit na u antwoord.
en: I look forward to your answer.

drills.en: Make it formal: use "u" instead of "jy"/"jou".

af: Die regering bou 'n nuwe hospitaal.
en: The government is building a new hospital.
The government builds a new hospital.

af: Die minister het gesê dat die projek volgende jaar sou begin.
en: The minister said that the project would start next year.
The minister said the project would start next year.
The minister said that the project would begin next year.

af: Die joernalis het die minister uitgevra.

to: 'n Nuwe hospitaal word deur die regering gebou.

drills.en: Rewrite as indirect speech (ons becomes hulle, sal becomes sou).
drills.from: Die minister het gesê: "Ons sal die probleem oplos."
to: Die minister het gesê dat hulle die probleem sou oplos.

drills.en: A question word stays at the front of the reported question.
drills.from: Die joernalis het gevra: "Wanneer begin die projek?"
to: Die joernalis het gevra wanneer die projek sou begin.
Die joernalis het gevra wanneer die projek begin het.
